solution_sketch: Last digits of 3^n cycle as 3, 9, 7, 1 with period 4 (from 3^1=3, 3^2=9, 3^3=27, 3^4=81). Since 2026 = 4·506 + 2, the last digit is the second entry in the cycle, which is 9.
difficulty_rationale: Naive route asks you to compute 3^2026, which is impossible mentally. The insight is that last digits of powers depend only on the exponent mod 4 — and the cycle 3, 9, 7, 1 falls out of writing 3, 9, 27, 81 in your head. 2026 mod 4 = 2 → second in the cycle → 9. The insight is reachable cold because everyone knows small powers of 3, and the cycle length is short enough to spot before the 20 seconds run out.
